name: Seer Wiserunner
summary: At his cave northwest of Bloodhoof Village, Seer Wiserunner guides young tauren through sacred rites. The respected elder helps them seek spiritual wisdom in Mulgore.

sections.title: A Guide on the Sacred Path
sections.body: Seer Wiserunner guides young tauren through their ancestral rites. After their first trials of strength and vision, they seek his counsel. He interprets visions of the Earth Mother and teaches them how to honor their forebears. His wisdom helps bind Mulgore’s scattered nomadic tribes into one community.

faq.answer: Seer Wiserunner is a respected tauren elder who guides young initiates through the sacred Rites of the Earthmother.

faq.q: What role does he play in Mulgore?
faq.answer: Seer Wiserunner mentors young tauren. After their early rites of vision, he receives the braves for the Rite of Wisdom and tests their readiness to serve their tribe and the Earth Mother.

faq.q: Where can Seer Wiserunner be found?
faq.answer: Seer Wiserunner can be found in a cave in the hills northwest of Bloodhoof Village. The vision from the Rite of Vision leads tauren youth there, and he sends them east of Thunder Bluff to the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks.

angles.text: As a young shu'halo venturing beyond Red Cloud Mesa, you can look to Seer Wiserunner for guidance on the ancestral journey toward spiritual maturity.
As a shaman, you can recognize Wiserunner as a keeper of ancient traditions who understands messages woven through the earth and sky.
